hero.title: Privacy and cookie policy
hero.subtitle: Transparency about your data and the technologies used by the site.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Your privacy is important to us. This page explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data, as well as the use of cookies on albergoalgobbo.it.
By browsing the site and using our contact or booking forms, you agree to the practices described in this notice.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs:
Albergo Al Gobbo
Campo San Geremia 312
30121 Venice (VE), Italy
Email: info@albergoalgobbo.it
Phone: +39 041 715125

sections.title: Data collected and purposes
paragraphs: We collect data that you voluntarily provide through our contact and booking forms: name, surname, email address, phone number and message content. This data is used solely to respond to your requests, manage bookings and provide you with the necessary information.
We also collect anonymous, aggregated browsing data (such as browser type, operating system and pages visited) to improve the site experience and detect any technical issues.

sections.title: Legal basis and retention
paragraphs: The processing of personal data is based on your consent, given by completing and submitting the forms, or on the performance of pre-contractual measures when you contact us for a booking.
Contact data is kept for as long as strictly necessary to handle your request and, in any case, no longer than 24 months from the last contact, unless otherwise required by law.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that the websites you visit send to your browser, where they are stored and then sent back to those sites on your next visit.
We use the following categories of cookies:
list: Technical and necessary cookies: essential for the site to work, for example to remember the selected language and manage cookie consent.
Analytics cookies: collect anonymous statistical information about visits and site usage to help us improve content. They are installed only if you give your consent.
Marketing cookies: used to show you personalised content and relevant advertisements. They are installed only if you give your consent.

sections.title: Cookie management
paragraphs: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by clicking the notice banner on the site or through your browser settings.
Most browsers allow you to view, manage and delete installed cookies. Please refer to your browser's help guide for specific instructions.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your personal data, request its rectification, erasure, restriction of processing or object to its use. You can exercise these rights at any time by writing to info@albergoalgobbo.it.
If you believe that the processing of your data violates applicable law, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: We reserve the right to update this notice to reflect any changes in legislation or service improvements. We encourage you to check this page periodically to stay informed.

hero.title: Albergo Al Gobbo
hero.subtitle: In the heart of Venice, steps from the train station

welcome.title: A small hotel, a big welcome
welcome.text: Albergo Al Gobbo is a small family-run hotel in the heart of Venice, in Campo San Geremia. Founded in 1930 by Mrs. Maria Vinco, it is still run by the Vinco family, who have been taking care of guests for three generations. Small, clean and a few steps from the station: here you will feel at home.

hero.title: Our story
hero.subtitle: Three generations of Venetian hospitality from the Vinco family

story.title: One hotel, one family
story.text: Albergo Al Gobbo was founded in 1930 by Mrs. Maria Vinco, who opened the doors of her home to travellers looking for a welcoming refuge in the heart of Venice. Ever since, for nearly a century, the Vinco family has preserved the same spirit: small thoughtful touches, impeccable cleanliness and a sincere smile for those arriving from afar. Today, in the third generation, we continue to offer a simple, authentic stay just steps from the station and the city's most beautiful sights.

timeline.title: Almost a century of hospitality
timeline.subtitle: From the very first guest to today, the same care for every detail.
